paragraph: He always shows great **determination** in everything he undertakes. They rise, not with force, but with quiet **determination**. No matter what happens, my **determination** won't change.
english: the act of determining, or the state of being determined

paragraph: Her ashes are **interred** here. Tom was **interred** in a small cemetery.
english: to bury in a grave

paragraph: He asked his parents if he could get his belly button **pierced**. I wouldn't let my daughter **pierce** her nose. **Pierce** whatever ear you want. It doesn't mean you're gay.
english: to puncture — see also puncture, perforate
arabicDesc: مثال: طلب من والديه إن كان باستطاعته أن يثقب صرته.

paragraph: He continues to suck his **thumb** like a child. All photographs are already on a **thumb** drive. I put the documents on a **thumb** drive.
english: the part of a slider that may be moved linearly along the slider

paragraph: The mayor has issued a stay-at-home **advisory**. The committee can only act in an **advisory** capacity. A wind **advisory** is in effect until the storm front passes.
english: giving advice

paragraph: I'm very self-**conscious** about the idea of death. He was breathing with difficulty, but he was **conscious**. I wasn't **conscious** that I was tapping my foot.
english: awake and aware

paragraph: Steel output set a record for two **consecutive** years. Stock prices declined for five **consecutive** days. Our team has lost two **consecutive** games.
english: following one after another

paragraph: An **endless** flow of tears fell from her eyes. These **endless** business trips are telling on his marriage. It's exhausting to keep up with his **endless** complaints.
english: never ending

paragraph: The **garbage**-can gave off a bad smell. Our **garbage** is collected three times a week. Don't forget to take out the **garbage**.
english: waste material
arabicDesc: مثال: أطلق صندوق القمامة رائحةً كريهة.

paragraph: Every card requires you to set a Personal **Identification** Number. You'll need a photograph of yourself for **identification**. Please have your boarding pass and **identification** ready.
english: the act of identifying (i.e., which one, which thing)

paragraph: It took me ten minutes to walk to the **metro** station. Where can we obtain a book of **metro** tickets? You can either walk there or take a **metro**.
english: an underground train system; a big city
arabicDesc: مثال: استغرقني المشي إلى محطة المترو -قطار الأنفاق- عشرة دقائق.

paragraph: He focused his business on the **metropolitan** area. These four youths share an apartment in the **metropolitan** area. A cold front is approaching the **metropolitan** region.
english: a bishop empowered to oversee other bishops

paragraph: Germany is a **parliamentary** republic. A **parliamentary** term lasts, as a rule, for four years. A **parliamentary** crisis is the last thing the country needs.
english: of, relating to, or enacted by a parliament
arabicDesc: مثال: ألمانيا جمهورية برلمانية.

paragraph: The reading of the day of rain is **proceeding**. The project is **proceeding** in fits and starts. The scientist insisted on **proceeding** with the research.
english: an action or event, often legal

paragraph: **Sadly**, my father no longer belongs to the group. **Sadly**, the best products are also the most expensive. **Sadly**, I have to wake up early every day.
english: unfortunately; in a sad way

paragraph: The building was preserved due to its historical **significance**. The familiar place had a new **significance** for her. Your thoughts are of no **significance** at all.
english: the extent to which something matters

paragraph: The **structural** integrity of the building is compromised. A door is much more than simply a **structural** component. Only a **structural** engineer can tell you whether the bridge is sound.
english: relating to the structure

paragraph: He lived on a **tropical** island in the Pacific. It seemed that they were interested in **tropical** fish. Hearing Spanish makes me think of beautiful **tropical** destinations.
english: of or pertaining to the tropics, the equatorial region between 23 degrees north and 23 degrees south

paragraph: I think it is **unnecessary** to talk about it. Avoid downloading **unnecessary** software, it slows down the computer. Remember to close **unnecessary** programs to save battery life.
english: not needed or necessary

paragraph: Did you find these at a **vintage** clothing shop? I bought it at the **vintage** clothing store. New **vintage** shops are popping up all over the city center.
english: old but of good quality

paragraph: It is necessary that we make a **reservation** in advance. Would it be possible to change my **reservation** now? I want to live in a Native American **reservation**.
english: arrangement by which something is secured in advance
arabicDesc: مثال: من الضروري أن نحجز مقدمًا.

paragraph: Being a **donor** has expanded his perspective on family. His journey as a **donor** has been highly rewarding. Would you like to be an organ **donor**?
english: one who makes a donation

paragraph: Didn't anyone teach you how to use an **indicator**? Frogs are an **indicator** of the health of the forest. I put on the left **indicator**.
english: a pointer or index that indicates something

paragraph: There really is such a thing as Internet **addiction**. He had to undergo therapy to overcome his **addiction**. It's not easy to break the chains of **addiction**.
english: the state of being addicted
arabicDesc: مثال: إدمان الإنترنت موجود حقا.

paragraph: Would you like shoe inserts for better **arch** support? There is a huge **arch** over the road. Do you see the **arch**?
english: an inverted U shape

paragraph: Why are you **squeezing** my hand? How much juice can you **squeeze** from one orange? Everyone **squeeze** together so I can take a picture.
english: to apply pressure (to something) from two or more sides at once
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تحزق يدي؟

paragraph: The company has a contract with the **supplier**. The company accepted a bill of exchange from its main **supplier**. I'm thinking about changing my **supplier**.
english: one who supplies
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مزودة، مورد، موردة

paragraph: My family **subscribes** to a newspaper. I'm going to **subscribe** to these chamber-music concerts. **Subscribe** and you will get a free cookie.
english: to write (one’s name) at the bottom of a document
arabicDesc: مثال: عائلتي مشتركة في جريدة.

paragraph: The **tomato** crop is of good quality. When was the last time you drank **tomato** juice? Would you like a **tomato** salad with your meat?
english: tomato plant
arabicDesc: مثال: محصول الطماطم جودته عالية.

paragraph: Why did you buy only one **banana**? He threw the **banana** away. You guys are going to eat your **bananas**.
english: the elongated curved tropical fruit of a banana plant, which grows in bunches and has a creamy flesh and a smooth skin
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا اشتريت موزة واحدة فقط؟

paragraph: Because the ice became soft, we had to call off the ice-**skating** party. Didn't I just tell you not to **skate** here? I don't ski, but I really like to **skate**.
english: ice skate or roller skate
arabicDesc: مثال: لأن الثلج أصبح خفيفا، اضطررنا إلى إلغاء حفلة التزلج.

paragraph: He is a member of the **parish** committee. Eleven years ago, there was a fire at the **parish**. They are the boys of the **parish**.
english: an administrative part of a diocese that has its own church

paragraph: Is she satisfied with being elected as **delegate**? Is she glad to have been chosen as a **delegate**? They **delegate** tasks to their team.
english: a person authorized to act as representative for another
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: وكيل

other.meaning: To commit tasks and responsibilities to others, especially subordinates (verb)

paragraph: The tourists **wandered** around the stores. Let's just **wander** and see where it takes us. Don't **wander** too far from shore, it's safer here.
english: to move without purpose or specified destination; often in search of livelihood
arabicDesc: مثال: تجول السياح حول المحلات التجارية .

paragraph: Their punishment was **harsh**, but just. The leading party faced **harsh** criticism from the opposition. The teacher wore a **harsh** expression on his face.
english: unpleasant and strong, or unkind
arabicDesc: مثال: كان عقابهم قاسيًا ولكنه عادل.

paragraph: He who wears **armor** falls with a big crash! The tank will be protected by a stronger **armor**. This is the best **armor** in the game.
english: a protective layer over a body, vehicle, or other object intended to deflect or diffuse damaging forces

paragraph: Where is the Japanese **Embassy**? He has worked in the **embassy** for three months. The **embassy** is located next to the Supreme Court.
english: organization representing a foreign state
arabicDesc: مثال: أين السفارة اليابانية؟

paragraph: The **mason** is having lunch in his truck. **Mason** planted a tree in the yard. Dr **Mason** placed his work above everything.
english: a bricklayer, one whose occupation is to build with stone or brick

paragraph: **Migration** to the US resumed under relaxed **migration** laws. This species holds the record for long-distance **migration**. Scientists use satellites to study the **migration** of whales.
english: an instance of moving to live in another place for a while

paragraph: If you want to take a dump, use the **bucket**. Well, I can cross that off my **bucket** list. That's one of the things on my **bucket** list.
english: a container made of rigid material, often with a handle, used to carry liquids or small items
arabicDesc: مثال: إن أردت تتبرز، فاستعمل الدلو.

paragraph: Every now and then they **clash** over their differences. The blue tie and red socks **clash** a bit. There was another **clash** a few months later.
english: a loud sound, like the crashing together of metal objects

paragraph: The **probe** is ready to be launched into space. Investigators are running a **probe** into what caused the crash. **Probe** into the cause of the accident.
english: any of various medical instruments used to explore wounds, organs, etc

paragraph: What would a million-year-old **civilization** be like? Cancel culture is a danger to the human **civilization**. If there are no standards, our **civilization** will collapse.
english: organized culture
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حضارة، تمدن

other.meaning: act or process of civilizing or becoming civilized

paragraph: I'm on a **par** with him in mental faculties. His command of English is on a **par** with mine. I am not feeling quite up to **par**.
english: the usual or expected standard

paragraph: A **spike** in demand caused prices to rise. The police laid out a **spike** strip on the road. Did you really **spike** the orange juice?
english: a sort of very large nail

paragraph: An hour ago, we received an **anonymous** phone call. An **anonymous** tip lead the police to the truth. This poem was written by an **anonymous** poet.
english: lacking a name

paragraph: I learned about different cultures and their **artistic** expressions. She was over thirty when her **artistic** talent emerged. The **artistic** beauty of the garden is truly amazing.
english: relating to art; having skill in art

paragraph: We need you to confirm your **attendance** because places are limited. We love competition and healthy **attendance**, with deep respect. He recorded **attendance** at the start of the day.
english: being present; the number of people present
arabicDesc: مثال: نريدك أن تؤكد حضورك لأن عدد الأماكن محدود.

paragraph: The history of the development of **aviation** is fascinating. The **aviation** expert analyzed the statistics in detail. **Aviation** does not forgive mistakes.
english: the art or science of making and flying aircraft
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ملاحة جوية

paragraph: Happy birthday, my **beloved** friend. You're beautiful, my **beloved**. Oh yes, you're beautiful. Nothing is as **beloved** as what one gets for free.
english: much loved, dearly loved
arabicDesc: مثال: عيد ميلاد سعيد, صديقي العزيز.

paragraph: There are controversial works referring to the **colonial** period. He dates the custom from the **colonial** days. There was little **colonial** presence in that country.
english: of or pertaining to a colony

paragraph: The factory was not in **compliance** with safety regulations. We are building your house in **compliance** with your wishes. The certification body evaluates **compliance** with industry standards and best practices.
english: an act of complying

paragraph: On the **contrary**, I've never said such a thing. And yet, the **contrary** is always true as well. What he has said is **contrary** to fact.
english: opposite
arabicDesc: مثال: على العكس، لم أقل ذلك قط.

paragraph: She has **diabetes** and so they chopped off her feet. Many people who have **diabetes** don't know they have it. **Diabetes** has been in their family for a long time!
english: diabetes mellitus
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ديابيطا

paragraph: Arabic **grammar** is hard to understand. You must study **grammar** more. **Grammar** is the art of speaking and writing well.
english: rules for speaking and writing a language
arabicDesc: مثال: النحو العربي صعب أن يفهم.

other.meaning: study of internal structure and use of words

paragraph: Mars had a **magnetic** field when it was young. So there is a **magnetic** field around earth. Can we create a **magnetic** field on Mars?
english: of, relating to, operating by, or caused by magnetism

paragraph: I always liked **mysterious** characters more. He arrived and departed in a completely **mysterious** way. He found a clue to solve the **mysterious** affair.
english: of unknown origin
arabicDesc: مثال: أحببتُ دائمًا الشخصيّاتِ الغامِضَةَ أكثر.

paragraph: Do not, under any circumstances, depend on a **partial** feeling. I can only afford to make a **partial** payment. That teacher tends to be **partial** to female students.
english: existing as a part or portion
arabicDesc: مثال: في كل الأحوال، إياك أن تنطلقَ من هوى نفسك.

paragraph: Your **propaganda** isn't scientific, and it doesn't seem effective. **Propaganda** of the deed was abandoned for a reason. All the media **propaganda** in the world didn't scare them.
english: agitation, publicity, public communication aimed at influencing an audience and furthering an agenda
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بروباغندا، دعاوة

paragraph: Are you learning two languages **simultaneously**? He is a scholar and a musician **simultaneously**. The summit talks are to be broadcast **simultaneously** throughout the world.
english: occurring at the same time
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تتعلم لغتين في وقت واحد؟

paragraph: This is the man framed by the **surveillance** cameras. Somebody tipped off the gang members to the police **surveillance**. You were acting suspicious, so they had you under **surveillance**.
english: watching people closely

paragraph: What reasoning could **underlie** their latest decision? The **underlying** causes of the problem are widely known. The principle **underlying** democracy is the division of power.
english: to be the basic cause of something

paragraph: I think that what happened was a little **unfair**. Why can she use the tablet? That is **unfair**! The new company rule was **unfair** to older workers.
english: not fair

paragraph: The oldest brother became a successful **trader**. A rich **trader** felt that the hour of his death was approaching. Islam was spread in this region by traveling **traders**.
english: one who earns a living by trading goods or securities
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تاجر، تاجرة

paragraph: She rides a **motorcycle** well. Their son is repairing a **motorcycle** in the garage. The **motorcycle** which I borrowed from him broke down.
english: open-seated motor vehicle with handlebars instead of a steering wheel
arabicDesc: مثال: قيادتها للدراجة النارية جيدة.

paragraph: Voice assistants did not live up to the **hype**. Is this what all the **hype** was about? Few fields have been more filled with **hype** than artificial intelligence.
english: exaggerated publicity

paragraph: There wasn't a **scrap** of truth in the statement. I've given my old bike to the **scrap** dealer. This car will soon have to go for **scrap**.
english: a (small) piece

paragraph: I'm hanging a picture of my **grandmother** on the wall. My **grandmother** always said it was a sin to waste food. She lived with her elderly **grandmother**.
english: a mother of someone's parent
arabicDesc: مثال: إني أعلق صورة لجدتي على الجدار.

paragraph: Are these my **socks** or your **socks**? Take off your **socks**, please. You have your right **sock** on wrong side out.
english: a knitted or woven covering for the foot
arabicDesc: مثال: هل هؤلاء جواربي أم جواربك؟

paragraph: She keeps a human **skull** on her desk. He only took off his **skull** cap in the shower. The boy fell off the bicycle and fractured his **skull**.
english: the main bones of the head considered as a unit

paragraph: Would you explain that **graph** to me? The differing volumes of carbon emissions are plotted in the **graph** below. The vertical axis of the **graph** depicts the volume of the crop.
english: a set of points constituting a graphical representation of a real function

paragraph: He pressed the button to **elevate** the bed. **Elevate** your thoughts to **elevate** your life. Work should **elevate** the human spirit.
english: to raise (something) to a higher position

paragraph: First, I saw lightning, and then I heard **thunder**. What should I do if it starts to **thunder**? People who talk like **thunder** rarely act like lightning.
english: sound caused by lightning

paragraph: The **puppy** was born without a tail. Our mother bought us a **puppy**. The **puppy** licked her cheek.
english: a young dog, especially before sexual maturity (12–18 months)
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد وُلد ذلك الجرو بدون ذيل.

paragraph: She has a **scar** on her face. How did you get that **scar** on your arm? I have a big **scar** on my left leg.
english: permanent mark on the skin
arabicDesc: مثال: لديها ندب في وجهها.

paragraph: Eliminating the **deficit** will be a very difficult job. He made up the **deficit** with a loan. The United States has a large trade **deficit**.
english: deficiency in amount or quality

paragraph: He put his bicycle in a **closet**. The **closet** door was open. Who was in the **closet**?
english: a small room within a house used to store clothing, food, or other household supplies
arabicDesc: مثال: وضع دراجته في خزانة جدارية.

paragraph: By and by the moon appeared on the **horizon**. The man watched the sun set below the **horizon**. We watch as the sun hides behind the **horizon**.
english: line that appears to separate the Earth from the sky

paragraph: I can make a **distinction** between good and bad. I'm not sure if that **distinction** is valid. He makes no **distinction** between right and wrong.
english: that which distinguishes

paragraph: The washing machine was one of the greatest **inventions** of all time. The devil is an **invention** of the human brain. Language is the most important **invention** of the man.
english: something invented
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت الغسّالة إحدى أعظم اختراعات البشرية.

paragraph: Who can calculate the **orbit** of his own soul? Gravity is what keeps planets in **orbit** around stars. They succeeded in putting an artificial satellite in **orbit**.
english: the curved path of one object around a point or another body
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: فلك

paragraph: The moon cast a soft **glow** over the land. Her cheeks began to **glow** at his compliments. You could see the **glow** of the fire for miles.
english: to emit heat and light without a flame

paragraph: Have you ever met a **zombie** at night? Why do you only watch **zombie** films? A **zombie** lives a life of its own now and then.
english: an apathetic or slow-witted person
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: الميت الحي

paragraph: Have you taken out a **subscription** to any magazine? The customer has a question about the **subscription** for you. This program requires a **subscription** for commercial use.
english: access to a resource for a period of time, generally for payment

paragraph: The **vampire** sprang back to life. The **vampire** suddenly woke up. I don't believe he knows what a **vampire** is.
english: a mythological creature (usually humanoid and undead) said to feed on the blood or life energy of the living
arabicDesc: مثال: عاد مصاص الدماء ذاك إلى الحياة.

paragraph: That man has a **foul** mouth. The water was **fouled** by oil. The police couldn't find any sign of **foul** play.
english: a breach of the rules of a game, especially one involving inappropriate contact with an opposing player in order to gain an advantage
arabicDesc: مثال: ذلك الرجل لديه فم كريه.

paragraph: What does that **needle** contain? Nothing is going to move the **needle** for them. Could you quickly thread this **needle** for me?
english: any slender, pointed object resembling a needle, such as a pointed crystal, a sharp pinnacle of rock, an obelisk, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا يوجد في تلك الحقنة؟

paragraph: He arranged a guest lecture from a local **historian**. The **historian** is investigating the ruins of this ancient city. What kind of **historian** are you?
english: a writer of history
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مؤرخة

paragraph: The store offers an **array** of fresh produce. I was impressed by the **array** of options. She dated an endless **array** of bad boys.
english: clothing and ornamentation

paragraph: I have been looking for **lemon** juice all day long. Hot **lemon** with honey is a good remedy for colds. A tea with **lemon**, please.
english: citrus fruit
arabicDesc: مثال: كنت أبحث عن عصير الليمون طيلة اليوم.

paragraph: Would you like to **swap** shoes for a day? She wishes she could **swap** places with him. Can I **swap** this one for that one?
english: to exchange or give (something) in an non-normal exchange (for something else)

paragraph: He settled at the foot of the **olive** tree. I have brought some **olive** oil from the country. How many bottles of **olive** oil should I buy?
english: a tree of species Olea europaea cultivated since ancient times in the Mediterranean for its fruit and the oil obtained from it
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: زيتي

other.meaning: Of a grayish green color, that of an unripe olive (adjective)

paragraph: You should speak in a **whisper** at the library. I want to **whisper** sweet nothings in your ear. I will love you till my last **whisper** gets out.
english: the act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords

other.meaning: To speak softly or under one's breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand (verb)

paragraph: **Compile** an essay on that topic within a fixed number of letters. His program would not **compile**. **Compiling** a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
english: to make by gathering pieces from various sources

paragraph: The maximum response time is listed in the **specification**. It is a new model with improved **specifications**. **Specifications** and price are subject to change.
english: an explicit set of requirements to be satisfied by a material, product, or service

paragraph: Don't put all your eggs in one **basket**. There is a **basket** under the table. The **basket** was filled with flowers.
english: a lightweight woven container, generally round, open at the top, and tapering toward the bottom
arabicDesc: مثال: ما تفعله محفوف بالمخاطر

paragraph: The hotel has **accommodation** for one hundred. The money collected allowed the construction of new **accommodation**. Is there any student **accommodation** with meals included?
english: lodging in a dwelling or similar living quarters afforded to travellers in hotels or on cruise ships, or students, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: يتسع الفندق لمئة شخص.

paragraph: She set a new Japanese record in the 100 meter **dash**. Would you like a **dash** of milk in your tea? They made a mad **dash** for the exit.
english: any of the following symbols: ‒ (figure dash), – (en dash), — (em dash), or ― (horizontal bar)
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شرطة

paragraph: Let's try to get a **booth** by the window. The party had a photo **booth** with fun props. He entered the **booth** to make a call.
english: a small stall for the display and sale of goods

other.meaning: an enclosure just big enough to accommodate one standing person

paragraph: Our town is a **hub** in the rail network. This station is an important **hub** in the local transport network. The lake was a **hub** of activity.
english: the center of an activity or network
